newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil inflation seen at 5 pct in 1997-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil inflation seen at 5 pct in 1997-paper.

text.p: Brazil's Economic Research Institute (Fipe) sees inflation below 10 percent for the whole of 1996 and around five percent in 1997, a newspaper said.

Fipe officials, who measure costs in the city of Sao Paulo, expect December's inflation rate to be close to zero, bringing inflation for the whole of 1996 to below 10 percent, Folha de Sao Paulo said. This would be the lowest rate since 1950 when annual inflation stood at 3.59 percent.
Fipe's forecast of five percent inflation in 1997 would be the lowest since 1946, Folha de Sao Paulo said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
